svg.title: The Egypt–Israel Peace Treaty, Sinai Return and Arab League Boycott (1978–82)
svg.desc: True conic conformal GIS historical atlas map of the Middle East and North Africa (1978–82), showing Egypt’s peace treaty with Israel, the staged return of the Sinai Peninsula (1979–April 1982), the Baghdad Summits Arab League boycott front, the relocation of Arab League headquarters from Cairo to Tunis, states maintaining ties (Sudan and Oman), and the October 1981 assassination of President Sadat.

text.tspan: Transferred from Cairo After Peace Treaty

svg.text: EDEXCEL GCSE HISTORY • KEY TOPIC 3: ATTEMPTS AT A SOLUTION
The Egypt–Israel Peace Treaty, Sinai Return & Arab League Boycott

g.text: First Arab peace; suspended by League
